name: Global Morphological Cosine Energy (DC Energy)
description: A frequency slaughterhouse targeting synthetically flat image masses. Measures the massive 'energy distribution' architecture inherent in the Discrete Cosine spectrum. A brutal sorting machine dedicated to ripping out bland low-frequencies from organic high-chaos to decisively prove an image was 'painted' by an AI neural brush or captured through authentic physical optics.
algorithm: Global Linear DCT Frequency Energy Dispersion
mechanism: Unlike conventional 8x8 DCT blockers, this engine violently forces the entire canvas into a spectral matrix to calculate global panoptic energy. The radar morbidly stares at the AC/DC threshold (foundational base-energy vs detail-energy). Hallucinated AI imagery desperately attempts to over-smooth objects, forcing the AC energy flux to hollow out into a terrifying, soulless void. This energy signature is so grotesque and mathematically unbalanced that the algorithm arrests it on the spot.
parameters: Linear Matrix: Global Fast DCT, Analytics: DC vs AC Energy Bandwidth Thresholds, Edge Decay Mapping
accuracy: Solid (70-76%) - Strongly enforces the unmasking of the vast majority of synthetically glossed, heavily filtered portraits.
source: Barni & Stamm (2012) - Spectral Density & Global Discrete Cosine Fracturing
useCase: Operates as a highly aggressive mine-sweeping radar across the global frame, instantly flagging a canvas if its textures are suspiciously, impossibly smooth (generative AI hallmarks or extreme synthetic skin-retouching tools).

references.title: Barni, M., et al. (2010). Forensic analysis of digital images: Spatial contrast and inconsistency. IEEE TFS.

strengths:
• Crushes the overarching structural integrity of the entire image with nominal hardware impact, violently ringing the alarm over fake AI clouds, skies, or plastic synthetic skin.
• Hyper-resilient against desperate blurring tactics by hackers; the more brutally an image is artificially blurred, the more violently the AC Higher Cosine Energy dies, exposing the forgery even faster.
limitations:
• The algorithm's judgment strikes completely blind (massive False Positives) against 100% native digital 2D illustrations (Vector Art, Anime, CGI shading) which are fundamentally synthesized as flat planes naturally.
• Accuracy plunges into the abyss if the synthetic AI output is sadistically peppered with enormous coarse-grain Gaussian static prior to export.
